content: Conjugated estrogens reach their peak plasma concentration approximately 8 hours after administration. About 80% of conjugated estrogens and 90% of medroxyprogesterone are bound to plasma proteins. Conjugated estrogens are metabolized in the liver into inactive sulfates and glucuronides, while medroxyprogesterone is also metabolized in the liver. The primary metabolites of conjugated estrogens include estradiol, estrone, and estriol. Conjugated estrogens are excreted primarily through the urine, although most estrogens are also excreted in bile and undergo enterohepatic recycling.
